gbm_population_evidence.quote: Glioblastoma; GBM; Glioblastoma Multiforme; Grade IV Astrocytoma
Have histologically confirmed World Health Organization Grade IV IDH wildtype glioblastoma or variants including gliosarcoma or IDH wildtype glioma with molecularly features of glioblastoma.

candidate_evidence.quote: Group A receives nivolumab plus ipilimumab
Nivolumab and ipilimumab have been used in other research studies, and information from those other research studies suggest these drugs may help to stop glioblastoma cells from growing.

treatment_setting_evidence.quote: Be at first or second relapse.

role_evidence.quote: Group A receives nivolumab plus ipilimumab

biomarkers.biomarker_other: Cell cycle-related genetic signature in tumour microenvironment

source_quote.quote: Multiplex IHC staining will be performed on tumor tissue to evaluate the influence of the neoadjuvant administration on the cell cycle-related genetic signature within the tumor microenvironment of recurrent glioblastoma.

coder_notes: Randomised 3-group neoadjuvant design; group C receives placebo before surgery then nivolumab plus ipilimumab, so placebo rows are listed as control_comparator while the post-surgery drugs are the same in all groups. Surgery is not an agent.
